description: Paid: 0.003 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.003 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Pay per call, solves one question: Is this x402 endpoint answering right now, and what does its unpaid 402 show? Raw 402 shape, network, asset, payTo ledger fields, TLS, latency, and uptime history. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

max_usd.description: Highest price you would pay, USD (default 0.10)

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

url.description: Full http(s) URL of the x402 endpoint to check

name: payradar
title: Pay Radar (alias of paycheck): pre-flight scan of an XRPL x402 endpoint before paying (paid: 0.003 RLUSD / 0.003 USDC on Base / 0.003 RLUSD on Base via x402)
